name: Global Undergraduate Exchange Program (Global UGRAD)
sponsor: Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (ECA) of the United States Department of State
academic_years: 2nd year of Bachelor's at the time of application deadline
merit_criteria: academic merit, leadership potential, and cultural adaptability
age_limit: between 18-24 years old by the deadline
other_conditions: Committed to returning to their home university following the completion of the program. Dual U.S./Pakistani nationals or U.S. permanent residents, employees of the Fulbright organization, the U.S. Department of State, or USAID and their spouses, siblings, children, dependents, and parents, and students who have been to the United States on a J-visa or a U.S. government-funded grant are ineligible.
benefits: Tuition, airfare, living stipends, health insurance, and provides opportunities for cultural exchange and leadership development.
application_procedure: Applications are submitted online through the USEFP website.
required_documents: Academic transcripts (including the most recent one confirming your CGPA), a personal statement, and certificates for any extracurricular activities within the last 5 years. An explanation of the university's grading scale is to be uploaded in case the CGPA or percentage is not mentioned on your transcript

name: Fulbright Degree Program
sponsor: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP) / U.S. government
eligible_institutions: universities all over the United States
fields_of_study: all academic disciplines, except clinical medicine
merit_criteria: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE General) is required for all applicants. Under the new scoring system, a minimum score of 145 is required on each section of the GRE examination, with a higher score on the section most applicable to your field of study. Selected candidates will be required to take TOEFL.
min_gpa_or_marks: minimum score of 145 is required on each section of the GRE examination
other_conditions: Pakistani citizens residing (throughout the process) in Pakistan. Master's requires 16 years of formal education (recent graduates encouraged, but MBA and Public Policy/Administration require 2 years work experience). PhD requires minimum 18 years formal education (work experience in teaching, research, or public sector highly desirable). Ineligible: dual U.S./Pakistani citizens, those with U.S. citizen/permanent resident spouse or child over 18, employees/contractors of Fulbright/State Dept/USAID and families, prior Fulbright recipients, and those already studying in U.S. or holding visas abroad. Must return to serve Pakistan on a year-for-year basis (minimum two years).
benefits: tuition, required textbooks, airfare, a living stipend, and health insurance. (GRE fee reimbursement available for up to 30 eligible applicants from HEC approved public universities)
application_procedure: An application with references and required supporting documents must be submitted online. Paper applications will not be accepted.
required_documents: An application form, Three reference letters, GRE score report, Scanned transcripts, including an explanation of the grading scale of the university issuing the degree
attestation_requirements: HEC-attested documents are preferable with the application but degree and transcripts attested by the issuing authority will be acceptable at the time of application. High school and post-secondary diplomas or certificates do not need to be officially verified/attested.
contact_address: Building No. 99, Sector H-8/1, Islamabad; Inside FC College, Gulberg, Lahore; Office no. 03-04, 5th Floor, 19 C, Khayaban-e-Nishat, Phase 6 DHA, Karachi
evidence_quote: The scholarship funds graduate study at universities all over the United States for a Master's or PhD degree, including tuition, required textbooks, airfare, a living stipend, and health insurance.

name: Fulbright Foreign Language Teaching Assistant (FLTA)
fields_of_study: English language or a related field
domicile_requirements: Pakistani national with a valid Pakistani Passport. Residing in Pakistan throughout the scholarship process.
min_gpa_or_marks: Minimum of 16 years of formal education.
other_conditions: Be a young, early career educator. Be a teacher of the English language or a related field at the college or university level/ English Language Teachers from Technical and Vocational Training Colleges/ Institutions are encouraged to apply. Prior teaching experience is preferred. Dependents are not allowed on this program.
benefits: Tuition, airfare, textbooks, a living stipend, and health insurance.
application_procedure: A complete application package, including academic transcripts, letters of reference must be submitted online by the application submission deadline. This is an online application. Paper copies will not be accepted.
required_documents: Academic transcripts, letters of reference, medical history and examination form, scanned copy of valid passport and No objection certificate (NOC) from employer / government of Pakistan.
evidence_quote: The FLTA Program is a nine-month, U.S. Department of State funded, non-degree program that provides young teachers of English an opportunity to refine their teaching skills
